invariants.rationale: A null value may not be expected for the argument, as the method immediately calls methods on 'name'.
'String.length()' is always non-negative, reflecting that 'name' is a valid String.
This states that if 'name' is not empty, its length is greater than 0, directly relating the two String properties.
A call to 'indexOf' returns -1 if not found, otherwise a non-negative index, so this is always true for any String.
'lastIndexOf' returns -1 if not found, or a non-negative index otherwise; always holds for any String.
